title: D2 generic error codes spec
description: Schema for contracts/error-codes/error-codes.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog that D2.Shared.Result.ErrorCodes.SourceGen reads to emit ErrorCodes.g.cs into D2.Shared.Result, and that tools/ts-codegen/src/error-codes-emit.ts reads to emit error-codes.g.ts into @d2/result.

code.description: Wire-format error code (SCREAMING_SNAKE). Must be unique across the spec. The literal IS the wire format.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status mapping. Drives transport-side response shape. Expanding the matrix requires extending this enum AND the codegen mapping (D2EC005 fires on unknown values).

doc.description: XML <summary> text rendered on the emitted constant + JSDoc on the emitted TS constant.
